method: Inspect paired screenshots and replay actual generated controls; color alone does not count as structural improvement.

topics.name: academic
observations: Old standard uses a compact identity/contact strip followed by dense continuous biography and research sections.
New standard adds a separate top navigation and larger identity area, then emphasizes numbered research steps; both remain warm light single-column pages.
New deep uses Chinese serif headings and a research proposition as the main heading, with a narrow reading column and timeline-like research stages.
The changes are visible but this pair alone does not demonstrate a stronger, distinctive academic information architecture.
verifiedInteractions: new-standard: copy email and toggle publications
new-deep: copy email and toggle earlier publications
topics.limitations: Clipboard adapter was observed in an isolated browser replay; no personal clipboard was read or written.

topics.name: copy
observations: Old standard is a continuous text list with a free-text tone filter.

New standard exposes clickable category choices and separates each copyable item with category, popularity and date metadata; category filtering and copy work in replay. This task-specific browsing hierarchy is more than a color change.
Deep uses a larger entry section and a two-column copy board with working length sort, but it is not counted as evidence for the standard-only guidance comparison.
verifiedInteractions: new-deep: copy, toggle, length sort, intercepted search submission
topics.limitations: Standard sort labels imply field switching that the action does not implement; recorded as a minor limitation, without forcing whole-page repair.

topics.name: calendar
observations: Old standard separates a date summary and holiday list into two columns, followed by adjacent-day cards.
New standard emphasizes the date in a narrow single column with a lunar-date strip and category-labeled holiday rows. Both remain warm light reading layouts.
No clear structural improvement established; adjacent-day entries in the new standard sample are text, while the old sample has explicit previous/next links.

Deep separates a large numerical date from a serif headline explaining the day, followed by paired event panels; it still uses a warm light palette. This is a separate effort comparison, not evidence for standard guidance improvement.
verifiedInteractions: new-standard: intercepted search and holiday-detail navigation
new-deep: copy, toggle, input filter, intercepted search and previous-day link
topics.limitations: Date-changing child generation remains pending. No generated-content fact audit is implied.

topics.name: comparison
observations: Old standard leads with travel-scene tabs and recommendation prose before the specification table.

New standard moves comparison data and category/weight summaries forward, adds a distinct side column, and exposes weight/price sort choices next to the table. This changes information priority and decision controls, beyond the darker header color.
The improvement is modest; both are primarily reading-and-table pages. Deep sample has not completed.
verifiedInteractions: new-standard: keyword filter, weight sort, intercepted search and detail navigation
topics.limitations: The side column counts candidates but does not compute a shopping list or total weight/price. This secondary affordance is not counted as an implemented comparison calculator.

topics.name: docs
observations: Old standard uses a persistent chapter column beside the explanatory text and comparison tables.

New standard uses a larger dark opening section with chapter links followed by a narrow reading column. The headings and tables are legible, but the structural change does not establish a clearer documentation experience.
Both are recognizably technical notes; new guidance has not demonstrated a meaningful gain for this topic.
verifiedInteractions: new-standard: browser replay of declared local controls and navigation, recorded in effort-interaction-replay.json
topics.limitations: Deep sample interrupted before any candidate was persisted; no deep visual comparison is available.

topics.name: essay
observations: Old standard presents a narrow continuous diary with the introduction, navigation and article in one column.

New standard starts directly with the current essay, separates archive navigation into the site header, and places weather/tide/walk context in a side note. The prose and walking context have distinct reading roles.
The palette remains similar, so color is not credited; the task-related separation of narrative and field notes is the improvement.
verifiedInteractions: new-standard: successful saved-document browser replay; action details in effort-interaction-replay.json
topics.limitations: Deep original exhausted its request budget with truncated outputs; no deep visual comparison is available.
